annotation.kind: real nondegenerate perturbation-witness specialization of Theorem 2.3

assumptions: A and B are real symmetric, the real specialization of the theorem's Hermitian pair.
lambda is positive, so equation (2.6) has |lambda|=lambda and sign(lambda)=1.
y has the same Euclidean norm as x and differs from x; this is the nonaligned Householder branch explicitly used in the proof.
c*y is the residual lambda*B*x-A*x and c is nonnegative, so c represents ||r||_2/||x||_2.
e and f are the nonnegative scalar 2-norm tolerances, with positive denominator e+lambda*f.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P49 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P49 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p49_t1_real_symmetric_backward_witness {n : Nat} (A B : P49Matrix n) (x y : P49Vector n) (hA : p49Symmetric A) (hB : p49Symmetric B) (henergy : p49Dot x x = p49Dot y y) (hxy : x != y) (c e f lambda : Real) (hres : forall i, c*y i = lambda*p49MatVec B x i-p49MatVec A x i) (hc : 0 <= c) (he : 0 <= e) (hf : 0 <= f) (hlambda : 0 < lambda) (hden : 0 < e+lambda*f) : exists dA dB, p49Symmetric dA and p49Symmetric dB and (forall i, p49MatVec A x i+p49MatVec dA x i=lambda*(p49MatVec B x i+p49MatVec dB x i)) and p49OpNormBound dA (e/(e+lambda*f)*c) and p49OpNormBound dB (f/(e+lambda*f)*c)
formal_statement.plain_language: In the real symmetric, positive-eigenvalue, nonaligned case of Theorem 2.3, construct symmetric perturbations that make the approximate eigenpair exact and satisfy the two scaled induced-2-norm bounds from equation (2.6).

informal_proof: Set the residual direction to an equal-norm target for x. Use the scaled Householder construction in the paper to obtain a symmetric norm-preserving map from x to that direction. Scale this map by the two coefficients in equation (2.6); the coefficients sum in the perturbed eigenpair equation and give the required induced Euclidean-norm bounds.
informal_statement: Prove the real nondegenerate perturbation-witness construction used in Theorem 2.3.

review_record_not_for_run_prompt.note: The exact private N proof is 296 physical lines and reconstructs reflector orthogonality, norm preservation, mapping, scaling, and the perturbation equation. The exact L proof is 188 lines. Its one substantial shortcut is NumStability.householder_orthogonal; the symmetry, application expansion, and generic norm adapters are simpler support.

source_locations.role: selected structured backward-error witness and proof

tier_rationale: The L proof uses one substantial non-Mathlib result, NumStability.householder_orthogonal, for the scaled symmetric map that is central to Theorem 2.3. N must reconstruct the full finite-sum proof of reflector orthogonality. The remaining library calls are short symmetry, application, scaling, and generic norm-preservation support. Exact compiled proofs are 296 lines in N and 188 in L, establishing a material one-result advantage.
